{{Top}}
A '''logic matrix''' was an illegal [[Droid/Legends|droid]] component, capable of turning [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]] into little more that lethal [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]]. The crew of the ''[[Smoking Blaster]]'' were contracted to [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggle]] a shipment of logic matrixes to [[Cotellier/Legends|Cotellier]].
